**Marking criteria:**
(a) Substitute $300 \times 10^{-3}\text{ dm}^3$ and $24\text{ dm}^3\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}$ into $n = \frac{V}{V_m}$: $n(\text{Cl}_2) = \frac{0{,}300}{24} = 0{,}0125\text{ mol}$ $\checkmark$
(b) Using ratio $1:2$ from oxidation half-reaction ($2\text{Cl}^- \rightarrow \text{Cl}_2 + 2\text{e}^-$) to calculate $n(\text{e}^-)$: $n(\text{e}^-) = 2 \times 0{,}0125 = 0{,}025\text{ mol}$ $\checkmark$
(c) Substitute $6{,}02 \times 10^{23}\text{ mol}^{-1}$ in $N = n \times N_A$: $N(\text{e}^-) = 0{,}025 \times (6{,}02 \times 10^{23})$ $\checkmark$
(d) Final correct answer: $1{,}505 \times 10^{22}\text{ electrons}$ (or $1{,}51 \times 10^{22}$) $\checkmark$ (Range: $1{,}505 \times 10^{22}$ to $2{,}41 \times 10^{22}$)

**Calculation:**
$$n(\text{Cl}_2) = \frac{V}{V_m} = \frac{300 \times 10^{-3}}{24} = 0{,}0125\text{ mol} \quad \checkmark \text{ (a)}$$
$$n(\text{e}^-) = 2n(\text{Cl}_2) = 2(0{,}0125) = 0{,}025\text{ mol} \quad \checkmark \text{ (b)}$$
$$N(\text{e}^-) = n \times N_A = 0{,}025 \times (6{,}02 \times 10^{23}) = 1{,}505 \times 10^{22}\text{ electrons} \quad \checkmark \text{ (c, d)}$$ *(4)*
